name: Trigenys Aegis
description: Multi-tenant security event ingestion and policy-driven threat monitoring platform with explainable AI triage and tamper-evident audit evidence.
brief: RAIDER-first security monitoring SaaS: tenant isolation, normalized signed event ingestion, deterministic detection rules, consent-driven automated response, verifiable evidence and future Python ML service. Bootstrap a generic TypeScript API only; do not deploy infrastructure, databases or chargeable services.
